summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running anything (read/edit only, nothing committed). Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs with keyboard handling, range_clicked click dispatch, and an animated bar via the _active_tab_name watcher); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges before width and now yields one Text object; Opacity merges blended color into existing style, preserving meta; layout resolver left unchanged because Edge already has size, min_size, and fraction; docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css; new tests appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py (plus tests/widgets/__init__.py). Judgment calls to review: the bar keeps full-list find_tab_by_name indices but maps them to displayed tabs for highlighting, which only differs when names repeat; letter search applies only to single-character keys; a zero-width label gets no label edge. Unverified: rich 11 Style meta merging on + and Text(end="") behavior, since the rich source lookup timed out. Tests have not been run.
